questions.prompt: Name a plant commonly grown as a houseplant.
questions.scope: Actual documented indoor houseplants, named groups/species/cultivars count. Do not accept every wild plant merely because it can temporarily fit in a pot.
questions.rationale: One independently proposed familiar whole subject, with a documented rare tail. Scientific names, named cultivars and recognized public plant groups remain answers inside each whole subject. Source metadata errors and ambiguous names are reviewed explicitly; no tag, year or source-row slices create prompts.
